\[
\begin{gathered}
S_x = \begin{bmatrix} 3 \\ 10 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix},
\qquad
S_y = S_x^{\mathsf T}
\end{gathered}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(S_x, S_y\): The Scharr kernels

A central difference across the edge and a 3, 10, 3 smoothing along it. Scharr chose these weights so that the error of the gradient direction is as small as possible for a 3x3 kernel. The weights are those of OpenCV's Scharr operator, without normalization.
